scope: Teacher prior only: development task descriptions, three supplied reference RGB images and capability goals. No historical student execution or development GT was supplied or inspected.

sources.observation: Prior is limited to task descriptions, reference RGB images and fixed capability goals.
Three editable single-image Blender reconstruction tasks share spatial, appearance and geometry verification goals.

observations: An office-like room contains two wheeled chairs, a table, shelving, a floor lamp and a paneled door.
The floor has repeated plank-like markings; furniture occludes parts of the room.
A small room shows a bed, shelving, a cabinet, two floor lamps and an open door.
Wall grid lines and the open door contribute perspective and occlusion cues.
A narrow kitchen-like room has an appliance on the left, cabinetry on the right and a plant near the rear opening.
Floor markings, counters and cabinet faces provide directional and perspective cues.

unit_origins.Joint camera, layout and semantic orient: General perspective knowledge, user capability goals and visible cues in the three RGB images; joint optimization and hinge checks are technical hypotheses, not tested development improvements.
unit_origins.Directional appearance and illumination: General shader and lighting knowledge and the appearance goal; procedural noise is a generic editable candidate, not a recovered material.
unit_origins.Support and assembly diagnostics: User-specified interpretation boundaries and general AABB and Blender assembly knowledge.

executed_tests.result: Passed in Blender 5.2.2 LTS with SYNTHETIC_CHECK_PASS; use_nodes deprecation warning for Blender 6.0.
executed_tests.coverage: Synthetic boxes exercise positive gap, near-zero, possible penetration and unknown support; one parent link; shader node link count; centered camera projection and zero landmark loss. No rendered appearance, surface contact or scene reconstruction was validated.

unknowns: Hidden geometry and absolute scale are not identifiable from a single image.
No Blender ground truth, historical student code, student candidate comparisons, or trajectories were available.
Material-light separation, scene-specific fit, hinge coherence in a built scene, and independent cross-scene improvement were not tested.
